messages:
maya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up: I drafted an SI co-sell handoff + ROE doc focused on lead routing, SFDC mapping, and exec overrides. Link: https://redwood.co/si-co-sell-v0.1 Please review and flag anything risky by Thu.
arjun (Sales): Nice. Couple clarifying Qs: 1) What constitutes an SI-originated lead vs co-sourced? 2) How do we credit pipeline?
maya (Partnerships): Short rules: SI-originated = SI initiated contact chain (email/intro) before Redwood outreach. Co-sourced = Redwood or customer reached out first and SI brought in. Credit lives in SFDC `partner_source` field.
lucy (SolutionsEng): For engineering routing we need a stable partner_code and partner_owner in SFDC. Also want `si_recon_id` for partner reconciliation.
maya (Partnerships): Added those fields in the sheet. Required tags: partner_code, partner_tier, si_ownership_expiry, si_contact_email.
sarah (SI-ops): I suggest we standardize partner tiers (Strategic / Preferred / Partner). Ownership windows vary by tier.
jen (AE): What's the ownership window per tier? we should bake this into the workflow.
maya (Partnerships): Proposed defaults: Strategic = 21 days, Preferred = 14 days, Partner = 7 days. Can be overridden for special deals via `executive_override`.
arjun (Sales): How does executive_override flow? who signs off?
maya (Partnerships): Exec override requires approvals from Partnerships lead + Sales director + partner exec rep. It writes a note in SFDC `override_approved_by` and timestamps. No unilateral skips.
mike (PartnerEng): On technical workshops: do we require a lightweight SOW or can we do an initial discovery call without paperwork?
devon (Legal): Discovery calls ok. Any paid workshop or customer-shared data requires SOW/NDA. I'll add a short SOW template to the doc and a checkbox `legal_signed`.
lucy (SolutionsEng): For automation: suggest a webhook that sets assignment and posts to #si-handoffs. Pseudo-rule:
```
if partner_code and source == 'SI' then assign = partner_owner else assign = AE_queue
tag: si:{partner_code}
set si_ownership_expiry based on partner_tier
```
lucy (SolutionsEng): I'll prototype Lambda to call SFDC intake and Slack webhook.
sarah (SI-ops): I'll own the monthly partner-account map refresh. For initial rollout I seeded three partners: AcmeInt, NorthCloud, TitanHW. Please verify owners.
arjun (Sales): We need a clear commission/rev split capture. can we store `rev_split_pct` and `comp_credits` in SFDC so ops can compute payouts?
maya (Partnerships): Added optional `rev_split_pct` and `si_pipeline_credit` fields. Ops will reconcile weekly.
devon (Legal): Note re: TitanHW: hardware shipments may trigger export control review. Tag those opps with `export_control_review`.
jen (AE): SLA ask from AE side: SI should acknowledge handoff within 48 hours if it's a warm lead.
maya (Partnerships): Proposed SLA: acknowledge within 48h, technical engagement within 7 business days for Strategic. Missed SLA flags `si_sla_missed` and reassigns after grace period.
arjun (Sales): Can we auto-notify Sales leadership on any SLA misses >72h?
lucy (SolutionsEng): Yep, webhook can emit to #eng-partners and DM Sales lead.
mike (PartnerEng): One more: joint announcements. What's the review window?
maya (Partnerships): Joint announcement requests must run a 10-business-day review by Partnerships + Legal. Put requests into the shared PRD folder and tag `announce_review`.
devon (Legal): I'll add a checklist: logos, quotes, approvals, any regulatory checks. Also require partner marketing contact.
sarah (SI-ops): Action items I captured: 1) Ops to publish partner-account CSV by Fri. 2) Lucy to stub webhook for handoffs. 3) Devon to attach SOW/NDA + announcement checklist. 4) Maya to publish v0.2 with SFDC field list and ROE logic.
maya (Partnerships): Thanks. I'll ping Sales leadership when v0.2 is live. Everyone, please add any edge cases in the doc comments. :raised_hands:
arjun (Sales): Will do. +1 on live doc, will review tonight.
